name: page-source
title: Page Source
description: A backend-agnostic contract for paged data (PageSource, PageRequest, PageResult), the kit adapters are built with, an in-memory arraySource, and createPageController, which derives the request, resets paging, debounces search, syncs the URL and writes the live region's status. Backend adapters are items of their own: page-source-rest, page-source-spring, page-source-cursor, page-source-relay and page-source-link.
docs: A `PageSource<T, F>` is `{ key, getId, capabilities, fetchPage(request, { signal }), fetchTotal? }`. `capabilities.position` is `"page"` or `"cursor"`; `total` says whether responses carry an exact count, an estimate or none, and navigation follows: page numbers with an exact total, previous and next with an estimate or only `hasMore`, load more for a cursor (`resolveNavigation`). Adapters build one from your `request` function and never fetch themselves. Each is an item of its own, named after what your backend speaks, so install only the one you call: `pagedSource({ base: 0 | 1 })` and `offsetSource` (`npx shadcn@latest add @eskais/page-source-rest`), `springPageSource` (`Page<T>`, or the PagedModel of `VIA_DTO`, `sort=field,asc` repeated) and `springSliceSource` (`npx shadcn@latest add @eskais/page-source-spring`), `cursorSource` (opaque, or `keyset` cursors built from the rows; `npx shadcn@latest add @eskais/page-source-cursor`), `relaySource` (`edges`/`pageInfo`/`totalCount`; `npx shadcn@latest add @eskais/page-source-relay`) and `linkHeaderSource` (parses `Link`, an estimate from `last`, exact on the last page; `npx shadcn@latest add @eskais/page-source-link`). For another protocol, write your own with the kit they share: `adapterSource(identity, capabilities, fetchPage)`, `pageNumberOf` or `cursorPositionOf(request)`, `appendParams`, `writeSort` and `restCallOf`, which builds the `RestCall` your `request` receives. Each adapter takes `params: (filter) => …` for a serializer's output and `read` or `select` to map another response. Return `readJson(response)` from `request` so a failed status throws an `HttpError` with `status`. `arraySource(items, { filter, search, sort, delay, fail, count })` pages an array in memory for demos and tests, honouring abort. With Effect: `fetchPage: (request, { signal }) => Effect.runPromise(program, { signal })`. `createPageController(source, { filter, sort, sortMode, pageSize, pageSizes, search, url, labels })` holds the state outside React: a new filter, sort or size returns to page 1 (or a null cursor), `setSearch` commits after 250 ms, `url: { adapter, codec, history }` keeps it in the URL (`connect()` follows back and forward), and `statusText(result)` writes "Showing 21–40 of 312" (`labels.range` translates it). `formatCount(value, locale)` writes a number with a cached `Intl.NumberFormat`; `labels.range(range, locale)` and `statusText(result, counted, locale)` take the locale the components resolve.
